facts.fact: Rohan has always read Dilan's rope end as a single clean slanted blade cut made from the near side, with no fraying, and has known for two winters that Dilan cut it himself.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires Rohan to have known privately (C03/C08 payoff).

facts.fact: Dilan sang his hymn, badly, all the way down the winter line while leading Kiran, saying it kept them off the ice; Kiran told him to shut up.
facts.why: needed because it gives meaning to Dilan's last words 'sorry about the hymn' and lands emotionally for Rohan.

facts.fact: Rohan publicly states that by the letter of the law his declining to arrest Kiran makes him a harbourer, and takes the responsibility before Asha's four.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires a public bend; the harbouring framing ties it to the Closing Law.

facts.fact: Meera writes in the count: 'R. did not reach. M. lied. Both stand.'
facts.why: needed because it marks the repair in her ledger voice; no plot impact.
